Uncompromising Safety, Uncompromised Views

One of the biggest misconceptions about safety and security film is that it has to be dark or reflective. The reality is that some of the most advanced and strongest films on the market are optically clear, providing robust protection that is virtually invisible once installed. This allows you to secure your property without sacrificing natural light or changing its architectural aesthetics.

The Technology of Invisible Strength

Clear safety films are a marvel of material science. They are crafted from multiple layers of high-tensile polyester, laminated together with aggressive adhesives. This multi-layered construction is what gives the film its incredible strength and tear resistance, not any kind of dark dye or metal particles.

The benefits of choosing a clear film are significant:

  • Maintains Aesthetics: Preserve the original design of your home or business. Clear film is ideal for historic buildings or properties with strict architectural guidelines.
  • Maximizes Natural Light: You don't have to choose between safety and a bright, welcoming interior. Clear films allow maximum visible light transmission.
  • Undetectable to Intruders: Because the film is invisible, a would-be burglar won't know it's there until their attempt to break the glass fails, costing them valuable time and creating noise.
  • Includes UV Protection: Even our crystal-clear safety films block over 99% of the sun's damaging UV rays, offering a valuable co-benefit of fade protection for your interiors.

The Best of Both Worlds: Combination Films

For clients who want invisible protection but also desire the benefits of solar control, we offer a range of combination films. These products integrate the heat and glare-rejecting technology of solar films with the thickness and strength of security films. You can have a lightly tinted film that provides significant energy savings, glare reduction, and robust security all in one package.

Frequently Asked Questions

How can a film be clear and still block UV rays?

UV light is a wavelength of the solar spectrum that is invisible to the human eye. Our films contain UV inhibitors that are specifically designed to absorb or reflect this invisible wavelength, without affecting the transmission of visible light.

Is clear safety film as strong as tinted security film?

Yes. The strength of a security film is determined by its thickness (measured in mils) and its adhesive quality, not its color. A clear 8-mil film is just as strong as a tinted 8-mil film.

Will the clear film turn yellow or cloudy over time?

No. We use only high-quality, professional-grade films with advanced adhesives that are guaranteed not to yellow, bubble, or peel for the life of their warranty.
